# Frontend Class Diagram — Client Service Layer

> 來源：FRONTEND.md §6.1 Screen × API 矩陣、§6.2 Auth Token 管理、§6.4 Request/Response 攔截器、§7 State Management；API.md §1 Endpoint。
> 客戶端為嵌入式 ERP（Razor + Alpine.js），**無獨立 SPA bundle**。所謂「服務層」為前端 JS 模組（位於 `wwwroot/js/`）+ Server PageModel 結合。

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class IApiClient {
        <<interface>>
        +get(url: String, queryParams: Object) Promise~Response~
        +post(url: String, body: Object, csrfToken: String) Promise~Response~
        +patch(url: String, body: Object, csrfToken: String) Promise~Response~
        +delete(url: String, csrfToken: String) Promise~Response~
    }

    class FetchApiClient {
        <<Service>>
        -_csrfToken : String
        -_baseUrl : String
        +get(url: String, queryParams: Object) Promise~Response~
        +post(url: String, body: Object, csrfToken: String) Promise~Response~
        +patch(url: String, body: Object, csrfToken: String) Promise~Response~
        +delete(url: String, csrfToken: String) Promise~Response~
        -_handleResponse(response: Response) Promise~Response~
        -_handle401(response: Response) void
        -_buildIdempotencyKey() String
    }

    class TokenApiService {
        <<Service>>
        -_apiClient : IApiClient
        +listMyTokens(status: String, page: Integer) Promise~PagedResult~TokenSummaryDto~~
        +createToken(req: CreateTokenRequest) Promise~CreatedTokenResponse~
        +revokeToken(tokenId: Guid) Promise~void~
        +updateDescription(tokenId: Guid, desc: String) Promise~TokenSummaryDto~
    }

    class AuditApiService {
        <<Service>>
        -_apiClient : IApiClient
        +listAuditEntries(filters: AuditFilters, page: Integer) Promise~PagedResult~AuditLogEntry~~
        +exportCsv(filters: AuditFilters) Promise~Blob~
    }

    class PocApiService {
        <<Service>>
        +callSales(bearerToken: String) Promise~SalesResponse~
        +callInventory(bearerToken: String, sku: String) Promise~InventoryResponse~
        +callOrderStatus(bearerToken: String, orderId: String) Promise~OrderStatusResponse~
    }

    class AlpineToastStore {
        <<AlpineStore>>
        +queue : List~ToastEntry~
        +show(kind: ToastKind, message: String, durationMs: Integer) void
        +dismiss(id: String) void
    }

    class CsrfTokenProvider {
        <<Service>>
        +getToken() String
        -_readFromInput() String
    }

    class CreateTokenRequest {
        <<DTO>>
        +description : String
        +idempotencyKey : Guid
    }

    class CreatedTokenResponse {
        <<DTO>>
        +tokenId : Guid
        +tokenPrefix : String
        +rawToken : String
        +createdAt : DateTimeOffset
    }

    class TokenSummaryDto {
        <<DTO>>
        +tokenId : Guid
        +tokenPrefix : String
        +description : String
        +status : TokenStatus
        +createdAt : DateTimeOffset
        +lastUsedAt : DateTimeOffset?
        +revokedAt : DateTimeOffset?
    }

    class AuditLogEntry {
        <<DTO>>
        +id : Guid
        +action : AuditAction
        +targetTokenId : Guid
        +targetTokenPrefix : String
        +actorUserId : String
        +actorUsername : String
        +ipAddress : String?
        +createdAt : DateTimeOffset
    }

    class AuditFilters {
        <<DTO>>
        +from : DateTimeOffset
        +to : DateTimeOffset
        +action : String?
        +actorUserId : String?
    }

    class PagedResult~T~ {
        <<DTO>>
        +items : List~T~
        +totalCount : Integer
        +page : Integer
        +pageSize : Integer
        +nextCursor : String?
    }

    class TokenStatus {
        <<enumeration>>
        Active
        Revoked
    }

    class AuditAction {
        <<enumeration>>
        Created
        Revoked
        DescribeUpdated
        AdminRevoked
    }

    class ToastKind {
        <<enumeration>>
        Success
        Error
        Warning
        Info
    }

    IApiClient <|.. FetchApiClient
    TokenApiService "1" *-- "1" IApiClient : uses
    AuditApiService "1" *-- "1" IApiClient : uses
    PocApiService ..> IApiClient : uses (without csrf for Bearer)
    FetchApiClient --> CsrfTokenProvider : reads
    FetchApiClient ..> AlpineToastStore : on 401 dispatches Toast

    TokenApiService ..> CreateTokenRequest : consumes
    TokenApiService ..> CreatedTokenResponse : returns
    TokenApiService ..> TokenSummaryDto : returns
    AuditApiService ..> AuditLogEntry : returns
    AuditApiService ..> AuditFilters : consumes
    TokenApiService ..> "PagedResult~TokenSummaryDto~" : returns

    TokenSummaryDto --> TokenStatus : has
    AuditLogEntry --> AuditAction : has
    AlpineToastStore --> ToastKind : uses
```

## Service 對應 API 路由（FRONTEND §6.1）

| Service 方法 | API Endpoint | HTTP | CSRF 必填 |
|-------------|-------------|------|----------|
| `TokenApiService.listMyTokens` | `GET /api/v1/me/tokens?status=&page=` | GET | 否 |
| `TokenApiService.createToken` | `POST /api/v1/me/tokens` | POST | ✅（Razor AntiForgery）|
| `TokenApiService.updateDescription` | `PATCH /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}` | PATCH | ✅ |
| `TokenApiService.revokeToken` | `DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}` | DELETE | ✅ |
| `AuditApiService.listAuditEntries` | `GET /api/v1/me/audit?from=&to=...` | GET | 否 |
| `AuditApiService.exportCsv` | `POST /api/v1/me/audit/export` | POST | ✅ |
| `PocApiService.callSales` | `GET /api/v1/demo/sales` (Bearer) | GET | N/A（Bearer）|
| `PocApiService.callInventory` | `GET /api/v1/demo/inventory` (Bearer) | GET | N/A |
| `PocApiService.callOrderStatus` | `GET /api/v1/demo/orders/{id}/status` (Bearer) | GET | N/A |

## Auth 機制

| 端點群 | 認證 | Header |
|--------|------|--------|
| `/api/v1/me/*` | ERP Cookie + AntiForgery | `Cookie: .AspNetCore.Cookies; X-CSRF-Token` |
| `/api/v1/demo/*` | Bearer Token（透過 P06 Test Console）| `Authorization: Bearer tk_...` |

## 技術說明

`FetchApiClient` 為瀏覽器原生 `fetch` 的薄封裝（`wwwroot/js/api-client.js`），統一注入 `X-CSRF-Token`、`Idempotency-Key`、`Cache-Control`，並處理 401 攔截 → Toast → redirect。`TokenApiService` 與 `AuditApiService` 透過 DI（Alpine.js 模組組合）依賴 `IApiClient`，符合 DIP。DTO 與 Server 端 API.md §6 schema 1:1 對應；Enum 來源為 SCHEMA.md / EDD §3.2。

## 白話說明

前端有一個共用的「叫 API 工具」，統一處理登入過期、CSRF 防偽 token、避免重複送出。Token 管理頁、審計頁、POC 測試頁各自呼叫自己的小服務，但都透過同一個工具底層發出網路請求。
